name: Andaman Islands
tagline: Pristine island incentive reward trips & ocean team-building
intro: Exclusive island getaways featuring white-sand beaches, catamaran cruises, and private beach galas for top performance awardees.
access: Flights from Delhi via Chennai or Kolkata; allow most of a travel day.
highlights: Genuinely novel for most Indian delegates, which matters when the trip is a reward rather than a meeting.
Water activities and island transfers build a shared experience that teams keep talking about.
No visa, no currency exchange, no international roaming to arrange.
planning_note: Inter-island ferries and flight capacity are the real constraints. Groups above about sixty need phased movement, which is a plan, not a problem — but it has to be built in from the start.
